OUR PROPOSAL — WHAT WE BUILT, MARKED IN RED

Direction chosen: Recommended-first strip and a compare tray inside the existing voice library, plus "Add your own voice" with a consent line. Only the voice id is a real write; multi-voice is Requires Engine.
Build in proto-01 per the verdict. Owner: may we say "Recommended" from tags before the benchmark?
